versions.changelog:
Initial release! Automatically discovers and claims e-commerce coupons for Taobao, JD, Pinduoduo, and Meituan.

- Supports auto-search and claiming of available coupons by product link.
- Finds hidden store coupons and calculates best coupon combinations.
- Reminds users before coupons expire; compares historical coupon deals.
- Free tier offers 5 queries/day; paid tiers unlock unlimited queries, auto-claiming, and reminders.
